name: aeon
description: Operator console for an Aeon agent instance: enable/schedule/edit skills, wire secrets and channels, debug runs, and mine past Codex/Claude Code chats into scheduled skills.

interface.shortDescription: Set up and run an Aeon autonomous agent instance from your coding agent
interface.longDescription: Aeon is an autonomous agent framework that runs your own skills on a schedule in GitHub Actions. This plugin ships the operator console skill: get started from scratch, turn skills on or off, schedule or reschedule what runs, edit what a skill does, debug a skill that will not fire, set the STRATEGY.md north star and soul voice, and mine past coding-agent chats into new scheduled skills. Works alongside the Aeon repo (aeonfun/aeon); the skill walks the rest.
defaultPrompt: Help me set up and run an Aeon agent instance
